name: debug-lib-env-filter
note: FALSE POSITIVE from the 2026-07-19 MCP scan (contributed to @launchdarkly/mcp-server@0.6.2). The ubiquitous `debug` npm library selects DEBUG_*/`^debug_` env vars (Object.keys(process.env).filter) to configure logging; paired with a normal outbound API call (a Speakeasy-generated SDK hitting its own documented endpoint with a user token), pkgxray reads this as bulk-env-harvest + exfil. It is not: no secret is placed in the request. RETUNE DEFERRED (network-exfil-or-loader is a core malware detector; narrowing needs an allow-list for the `debug` env-filter shape + own-API destinations, done per-case). Remove knownFalsePositive once network-exfil-or-loader distinguishes the debug env-filter from an env harvest.
